thread:
sophia: Quick sync  opened a small PR that cleans up a handful of glossary keys, tweaks style-guide phrasing, and updates 2 SDK snippets. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/5320 — please eyeball when you get a sec.
marc: thanks. which snippets changed?
sophia: JS quick example: renamed client param from `apiKey` -> `api_key` in internal examples; Python quickstart keeps visible alias but shows recommended catalog id in a comment. also fixed a tiny Go doc comment.
toni: can we avoid replacing the visible values in public quickstarts? lots of copy/paste.
sophia: yup left visible values as-is for public quickstarts and added a short inline note with the new recommended form.
devx: paste the deprecation blurb so editorial can check the tone.
sophia: "Deprecated: legacy model alias `gpt-legacy` is scheduled for removal. Use explicit catalog ids (for example, `rw/gpt-small`) for stable behavior."
toni: shorten to a scannable form: "Deprecated: `gpt-legacy`. Use `rw/<model-id>`." keeps it clearer in snippets.
editorial-bot: suggestion: prefer 'we' in procedural steps and avoid directives like 'you must'. Also: allow contractions in conversational examples, but avoid them in security/auth warnings.
marc: thanks. Are there any anchor renames that could break links? I remember a previous rename from "inference runtime" to "serving runtime" causing breakage.
sophia: this PR renames a small set of keys (e.g., "deployment runtime" -> "serving runtime"). I added redirect anchors in glossary.yml and kept duplicate HTML anchors on the page so old links still resolve. Updated internal links where obvious.
linkbot: preview build: https://deployments.preview/redwood/docs/5320 — linkcheck reports 1 external 404 (old support KB).
sophia: fixed that in the branch, added redirect to support/faq-auth and updated the page that referenced it.
devx: can you add migration helpers? a couple of sed/ripgrep lines would be helpful for teams sweeping repos.
sophia: added a short migration section with examples: Mac sed: `rg "gpt-legacy" -l | xargs -I{} sed -i '' "s/gpt-legacy/rw\/gpt-small/g" {}`; Linux sed: `rg "gpt-legacy" -l | xargs -I{} sed -i "s/gpt-legacy/rw\/gpt-small/g" {}`; plus `npm`/`pip` upgrade hints.
toni: include a one-line npm/pip so users can update clients: `npm i @redwoodai/sdk@latest` and `pip install --upgrade redwood-sdk`.
sophia: added both.
marc: CI note  please schedule docs/regenerate-snapshots and linkcheck after merge.
sophia: added the CI job to the PR and requested editorial review. aiming to merge today if no blockers.
toni: LGTM from eng; editorial will do a quick pass post-merge on contraction guidance.
devx: I can add a short release-note entry after merge: "Docs: glossary cleanup, phrasebank tag harmonization, SDK snippet improvements."
sophia: perfect — thanks all. Ping me here if you spot anything blocking before I merge at 5pm PT. :rocket:
